additional_info.subject: 0462680 - ID0462680-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / S3 170003441] Meter_BC6_AC_Input error CRM:00472000503
additional_info.body:
Dear Rasmus,
The R&D Team was able to identified the problem. They notice that we have on field different versions of FW in the PAC meters.
The different versions have a specific register that we use. That's the reason for the active flag.
Solution is to have all PAC meters using same version. R&D is currently studying how they will do a remote update on the affected chargers.
Since the root cause is identified I will proceed to close this ticket. We will share later when the fix will be applied.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
